newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aegon has one billion guilder war chest.
newsitem.headline: Aegon has one billion guilder war chest.

text.p: Insurer Aegon NV said on Friday it had a war chest of around one billion guilders for acquisitions, but that bigger take-overs were not ruled out.
"As we showed with the take-over of (U.S. insurer) Providian we can also issue shares to make big take-overs," Aegon chairman Kees Storm told a results news conference.
Aegon's leeway to acquire new companies was thus far more extensive than the one billion guilders would suggest, he said.
"The war chest is what we can use quickly, if the need arises," he said.
But Storm reiterated Aegon's first priority was to pursue organic growth, followed by acquisitions in countries in which it already had a major presence and thirdly "greenfield" operations.
He said the insurer would be "highly selective" in venturing into new markets.
Aegon already has a foothold in Taiwan and acquired a licence for the Philippines in November last year.
It was also looking at opening a representative office in China and tentatively at India, while Thailand was also "on the list", Storm said.
However, all these markets were small in terms of premium income and no major investments would be made, he added.
Closer to home, Aegon was eyeing the possibilities offered by the Czech Republic, Poland and Scandinavia, he said.
